verdict.rationale: Lighthouse's own homepage says its case platform handles document uploads and tracks which items are ready, so evidence collection does run through a product workflow rather than email attachments. That is a single marketing line with no further detail. missing for 10: documented checklists or per-case evidence requirement lists, automated reminders or nudges for outstanding documents, detailed product docs on the upload workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, evidence and document collection runs through a structured workflow (checklists, uploads, reminders) rather than email attachments

citations.quote: Our platform simplifies every step of your case preparation, from uploading documents to tracking what is ready.
